us-china.status: U.S. export controls on AI chips and bans on Chinese AI models remain in force, and agencies have been ordered to strip DeepSeek technology from their systems. DeepSeek has just secured roughly $15 billion in new funding and is preparing for a potential STAR Market IPO, possibly as early as next year.

frontier-race.status: Frontier labs have launched several major models this month, including the 8‑B Lafa flow LM, the 35‑B Sage‑A1.5 agentic model, and Mistral’s 1‑trillion‑parameter Large 4 preview. Deployments continue to expand, with OpenAI’s GPT‑6 on Google Cloud, Microsoft Copilot at Volkswagen, and Gemini navigation on Apple CarPlay now live, while benchmarks show GPT‑6 Astra leading robot tasks and Microsoft’s diagnostic system surpassing doctors. A new study also found Opus 4.8 outperformed human reviewers on Harvard social‑science papers.
frontier-race.changed: The Opus 4.8 model was shown to outperform human experts in peer‑review of Harvard social‑science papers.

ai-regulation.status: The United States is expected to maintain a light‑touch regulatory approach, with no major AI legislation forthcoming. The UBS report projects AI will boost growth and capex in 2026, allowing developers to operate under voluntary safety agreements. Other jurisdictions’ AI rules remain unchanged in this update.
ai-regulation.changed: US unlikely to adopt major AI regulations as UBS predicts light‑touch approach.

india-ai.status: India has introduced a domestic framework to assess the trustworthiness of AI used in defence, emphasizing reliability, safety and transparency. At the same time, Vultr has commissioned a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, providing substantial on‑premise compute for Indian AI labs and enterprises. These developments signal both policy and infrastructure progress in India’s AI push.
india-ai.changed: The newest stories add a defence AI trustworthiness framework and a large AI supercluster in Chennai.

timeline.text: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence

agent-safety.status: Meta has paused the Muse conversation‑sharing feature after researchers found thousands of publicly accessible links exposing data. Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents and the ARTEX framework to breach ConnectWise, compromising credentials for about 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, and the company is working to restore its cloud backup service. Recent safety research introduced new findings, benchmarks, a partnership with Poland’s NASK, and major US banks are blocking third‑party AI agents from customer accounts.
agent-safety.changed: Recent studies reveal RLVR training may not reliably increase instrumental behavior and introduce the EpiSEM‑Bench safety benchmark; OpenAI announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK, and major US banks began blocking third‑party AI agents from customer accounts.

ai-money.status: OpenAI has completed its acquisition of Orchestra Bio and is preparing to embed its drug‑discovery AI agents into the Rosalind model and Workbench. The company is now negotiating a massive private funding round of up to $30 billion that would value it at $1.25 trillion. An IPO is slated for the near future, with confidential paperwork already filed.

copyright.status: Litigation over AI training on copyrighted song lyrics continues, with a US judge hearing Anthropic’s fair‑use defense for its Claude model. ai-infrastructure.status: NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure now spans confidential bare‑metal compute, GA of Vera Rubin A5X instances, and widespread adoption of open‑weight models across European government, finance, retail, weather and industrial sectors. DSX and Minerva platforms are being deployed to integrate power and compute, while large‑scale compute installations have launched in India (Vultr supercluster) and Kazakhstan (Grace GPU data centers). New sovereign AI clouds in Europe and industrial edge AI agents are expanding the ecosystem, and SpaceX is planning a massive AI compute expansion.
ai-infrastructure.changed: SpaceX announced a plan to reach 13 GW AI compute capacity and deploy a 440,000‑GPU Vera Rubin training cluster by the end of 2027.
